motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: House easing for movement: entrances, hovers, disclosures, view transitions.

motion.name: hero-in
motion.value: 1.4s ease; from opacity 0, translateY(24px) scale(0.98) blur(10px); 0 / 0.15s / 0.3s stagger
motion.purpose: Hero name, intro and links blur into focus on load.

motion.name: statement-scroll
motion.value: 240vh sticky stage; word opacity clamp(0.18, p*(n+6)-i-2, 1)
motion.purpose: Statement words brighten one by one with scroll.

motion.name: showcase-scale
motion.value: scale 0.88 to 1, opacity 0.35 to 1, linked to scroll from viewport 100% to 35%
motion.purpose: Chapter showcase tiles grow into place.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 1s ease, translateY(40px) to 0 with opacity; once, only if offscreen at load
motion.purpose: Quiet supporting entrance for headings, rows and copy.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Number tiles count to their value.

motion.name: trace-clock
motion.value: 7000ms play + 2200ms hold per trace; one --t custom property
motion.purpose: Live trace replay; pauses offscreen, in hidden tabs, on demand.

motion.name: figure-draw
motion.value: grow 900ms with 500ms (stages) / 180ms (bars) stagger; flow steps rise 800ms with 140ms stagger
motion.purpose: Figures draw in once on entry.

motion.name: hover
motion.value: 200ms opacity/background; chevron nudge 3px over 220ms; next-project arrow 6px over 240ms

motion.name: page-transition
motion.value: view transition: old 180ms fade out, new 420ms fade up 12px; nav held
motion.purpose: Route changes cross-fade under a still nav bar.

motion.name: footnote-landed
motion.purpose: Highlights the footnote just jumped to.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all transitions and animations off; scroll values set to 1; trace shows finished state
motion.purpose: Everything is static and complete under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.note: Project-page figures break out 140px each side.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.note: Numbers two columns; flow stacks vertically.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: Nav links hide; single-column numbers, rows and facts; trace stacks label over bar; tile-compact radius on the trace.

narrative.overview:
Matt is presented the way Apple presents a product: one idea per screen, big confident type, the work shown running, and every number backed by a footnote. A visit reads as a sequence of full-width moments: a centred name and one plain sentence, a statement that lights up word by word as it scrolls past, three project chapters whose showcase tiles grow into place, a grid of footnoted numbers, expandable experience rows, and a closing "Email me." set as large as the name. The work itself sits inside soft grey tiles on a true black ground, and the first showcase is a live trace replay rather than a picture of one.

The palette is almost colourless. Black ground, one step of graphite for tiles, three greys of ink, and a single link blue for every action. Colour beyond that blue lives only inside the live trace, where four colour-blind-validated service hues and three status hues encode data. Type is one family, Inter with optical sizing, tracked tight at display sizes and relaxed at body sizes; JetBrains Mono appears only where the reader is reading data. Depth comes from tone, never shadow: the only material effect is the translucent, blurred 48px navigation bar.

Dark is the default theme and the one the world was built in; light is a full alternate that maps every role to an Apple-light equivalent (white ground, #f5f5f7 tiles, #1d1d1f ink, #0066cc link). Motion is generous but always optional: everything is visible by default, scroll-linked effects resolve to their end state under reduced motion, and the live trace pauses offscreen, in hidden tabs, and on demand. The site rejects dense dashboards, kicker labels and decorative chrome.
keyCharacteristics: True black (or white) ground with graphite tiles at a 28px radius.
One link blue for every action, written as chevron text links.
Inter with optical sizing, 700 weight, tight negative tracking at display sizes, centred.
Colour beyond blue appears only inside the live trace, as data.
Flat tonal depth; the blurred nav bar is the one translucent surface.
Scroll-driven signature motion, fully static under reduced motion.
Numbers carry superscript footnote links to a small grey footnote block.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Outside the live trace, Link Blue is the only chromatic colour on the page. It marks every action and, in figures, is the single data hue (as tints). A second accent is outside this world.

rules.name: The Trace Quarantine Rule
rules.body: The four service colours and three status colours appear only inside the live trace. They never colour a heading, link, tile or figure elsewhere.

rules.name: The White-On-Blue Rule
rules.body: White text sits only on Deep Link Blue (#0066cc) or darker. Sky Link Blue is a text colour, not a fill for white text (3.0:1).

rules.name: The Tighten-With-Size Rule
rules.body: Tracking scales with size: -0.01em at 12 to 15px, -0.022em at body, -0.025em to -0.03em at lede and title, -0.035em at section and statement sizes, -0.04em at display. The floor is -0.04em.

rules.name: The Data-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is used only for trace names, durations, ticks and protocol labels: things a reader would copy from a log. Words that explain are always Inter.

rules.name: The Weight Steps Rule
rules.body: Weights are 400, 500, 600, 650 and 700, nothing lighter. Emphasis comes from size and weight, never from colour or gradient.

rules.name: The Tone-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface is raised by one tonal step, never by a shadow or glow. If something needs to stand forward, it moves to the next grey.

rules.name: The One Veil Rule
rules.body: Blur and translucency belong to the sticky navigation bar alone. Tiles, cards and controls are opaque.

dos: Do put one idea per screen: a centred heading of 64px or more, at most one lede, then the work.
Do write every action as a Link Blue chevron text link unless it sits in a project-page hero.
Do place work inside Graphite Tiles (#161617, 28px radius) on the black ground, with inner cards cut back to the ground colour at 18px.
Do attach a superscript footnote to every large number and keep the conditions in the footnote block.
Do keep everything visible by default: entrances arm only for elements that start offscreen, scroll-linked values resolve to 1 under reduced motion, and the trace shows its finished state.
Do use the house easing `cubic-bezier(0.28, 0.11, 0.32, 1)` for movement and `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for fades.
Do give each new signature moment its own motion; the 40px rise-in is the quiet supporting entrance, not a template for every section.
Do theme browser surfaces from the palette: selection in Selection Blue, focus in a 2px Link Blue ring, tabular numerals in dates, durations and counts.
Do build both themes from the same roles; dark ships by default.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour, or use service or status colours outside the live trace.
Don't put white text on Sky Link Blue (#2997ff); fill with Deep Link Blue (#0066cc) instead.
Don't use box-shadows, glows or outlines on tiles; raise by one tonal step.
Don't use blur or translucency anywhere but the navigation bar.
Don't set kicker or eyebrow labels above headings; the heading speaks alone.
Don't use gradients for decoration or text. The only gradients are data encodings in the trace: quarter gridlines and the stalled-span hatch.
Don't set explanatory words in JetBrains Mono.
Don't track display type tighter than -0.04em or set weights below 400.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons; icons are Feather (react-icons/fi) at 16px.
Don't fill pages with dense dashboard grids; the number tiles are the one grid of stats.
